title: Fan-out analysis worker return
description: Compact, citation-bearing summary a read-only fan-out worker returns to the conductor. Paths plus claims, never raw file dumps.

unit.description: The analysis unit this worker was assigned during decompose.

status.description: How completely the worker covered its unit.

claims.description: The findings — each a terse claim backed by at least one citation. This is the whole payload the conductor synthesizes from.

claim.description: A single terse assertion, NOT a file excerpt.

confidence.description: How strongly the citations support the claim.

citations.description: Where the claim is grounded — path plus optional line range and symbol, never pasted content.

lines.description: A line or range, e.g. "42" or "42-58".

open_questions.description: Gaps the worker could not resolve within its unit.
